children.value: > Fact From Story: Manchester United, one of the grandest and richest names in this competition, have again gone out of the Champions League at the group stage.
> > Fact From Story: The performance this season was so bad that they find themselves out of Europe altogether as the bottom team in the group
> > > Fact From Story: It is the third time it has happened since Sir Alex Ferguson, meaning it’s their most common round of exit in that period.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Teams that perform badly in a competition are likely to be eliminated.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: The Champions League is a European competition.
> Commonsense Knowledge: When a team is out of the Champions League group stage, they are out of Europe.
